goal: Lock an evidence-backed, differentiated offer with explicit unit economics and pricing guardrails.
stop_conditions: Do not set canonical prices from competitor averages alone.
Do not scale paid acquisition until contribution economics are known.
Do not promote if real production-cost inputs are still entirely unknown; scenario models may guide discovery but are not canonical economics.
promotion_rule: Offer architecture, positioning and pricing logic are evidence-backed; package contribution margins are computable; material assumptions are explicit; no P0/P1 remains.
